what: HELD-OUT question list for the search page's section search. Written and committed BEFORE the search engine's second round of changes (a stemmed word index with a 'lead' list, meaning search across the shelf Acts); to be run ONCE after those changes. The first 48 questions (search_gold_questions.json) were run before the changes, their misses were read, and so they are the TUNING set.
written_by: Claude (2026-10-23), from its own knowledge of the Indian statutes: not lawyer-made, not independently checked. A wrong expected section counts as a miss against the search.
rule: Hit at 5 / at 10: at least one of the expected (Act code, section) is among the first 5 / 10 PROVISIONS of the result. ACT_SHELF=on.
